description: Latest mark price of one Hyperliquid market as a single number: native perps, HIP-3 builder perps (e.g. xyz:NVDA-PERP) and spot. The quickest answer to 'what is X trading at'. For the oracle price and funding use get_mark_prices; for price history use get_candles; to compare many markets at once use get_markets_snapshot.
